name: Somchai Srisawat
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport started with a childhood fascination for the roaring engines at local racing events. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in quality assurance, driven by a desire to ensure peak performance and reliability. His meticulous nature and sharp eye for detail quickly made him a valuable asset in the automotive industry.

He joined Team WRT three years ago, bringing his expertise to bear on their racing program. Somchai is deeply committed to identifying and rectifying potential issues before they can impact the team's performance on the track. His colleagues appreciate his methodical approach and his ability to find creative solutions to complex problems. Somchai believes in continuous improvement, constantly researching new technologies and processes to enhance the team's quality control measures. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure, a trait that allows him to make sound judgments even in high-stakes situations. 

What distinguishes Somchai is his knack for combining technical expertise with innovative thinking. While firmly grounded in established quality control methodologies, he also seeks out opportunities to introduce novel approaches, always striving to improve the team’s competitive edge through enhanced reliability and precision.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Somchai is of average height with a lean build, always maintaining a focused gaze.

Has a collection of miniature racing cars on his desk.
Insists on calibrating his tools every morning before starting work.
